name: 设置 > 桌面、锁屏与个性化 > 图标 > ART+ 图标
why: ART+ draws third-party icons (淘宝, 京东, 拼多多, 哔哩哔哩...) in a clean house style, which hides festival and promotion decorations.
consent_note: Two notices: 壁纸 (full mode uploads chosen images for AI) and 壁纸与个性化 (storage, network). Ask the user first.
notes: The ART+ switch row uses id art_switch and title art_text, so `on` finds it by the row text. Do not change the icon style chips.
